finding.title: HTML5 entity caption changes semantics and invalidates block after Author title-only save
finding.root_cause: wp_kses_normalize_entities executes before pre_kses, conflating some HTML5 references and literal entity text

checks.name: administrator: official 1.1.1 retains complete native fixtures
author: official 1.1.1 retains complete native fixtures
